''No—! I can't stand it—!'' Let me ''stop!'' Don't make me do this any more—!''"
"''Kessel has only surrendered ''two'' of the hundreds of Rebels ''known'' to be on the planet—! You will ''destroy'' the planet or you will ''never'' see your daughter again!|Professor Renn Volz and Captain Bzorn|}} During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Little Kessel]] was home to hundreds of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] traveled to Little Kessel aboard the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']] and demanded that all Rebels on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] be surrendered. When the government of Little Kessel refused, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tormented the planet with [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and cyclones. {{Battle-stub}} ==Appearances== *"[[The Second Kessel Run]]" {{Reprint|The Second Kessel Run}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|36|The Unseen Planets of Star Wars|The Unseen Planets of ''Star Wars''}} *{{CSWECite|II||''Ionic Ring''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{GCW 0 ABY}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Little Kessel, devastation of}} [[Category:Artificial disasters]] [[Category:Battles in the Kessel sector]] [[Category:Battles of the Galactic Civil War]]
